item.subject: science
item.chapter_label: Mindful eating: a path to a healthy body
item.stem:
Meena's grandmother says that a meal is balanced only if it makes the stomach feel completely full. Meena learns in school that a balanced diet must contain all essential nutrients, roughage and water in the right amounts for proper growth and development.

Which statement about a balanced diet is correct?

options.A: A diet is balanced if it fills the stomach, even if roughage or water is missing.
options.B: A balanced diet contains all essential nutrients, roughage and water in the right amounts, and these needs can change with age.
options.C: A child and a grandparent need exactly the same types and amounts of nutrients.
options.D: A diet is balanced if it has many different food items, even without checking the amounts.
